dataset_title: CIC-IDS-2017, improved release (Engelen, Liu et al., CNS 2022)
caveat: Lab datasets captured in 2015 (UNSW-NB15) and 2017 (CIC-IDS-2017). Scores on them say little about a real network today; the cross-dataset test (step 16) measures how badly the models transfer. Thresholds were chosen on validation time blocks the training split does not touch, and the test split was scored once. The uncleaned variant shows what the same pipeline reports without the leakage controls and is not a usable model.

calibration_study.rule: Lower mean calibration error wins: |FPR reached on test / target FPR - 1|, averaged over both datasets, both models, both targets and seeds 0-2 (cleaned variant). time-block wins a difference under 0.05, being one fit instead of six. random is measured, never chosen. The choice uses the test split, once, to pick a method, never a threshold.
